macros.m_description: Unlock / Falcon khulne par MacroDroid ki dono accessibility services (Screen Content + UI Interaction) band hon to khud ON. Bank app saamne ho to nahi (Bank mode ke liye).

(+ patch: phone par lage macro ka ek hissa badalna, chaabi phone se bahar nahi) Har 5 min GitHub (Noor-traders-/md) dekhta hai. Naya version ho to pehle backup, phir Claude ke macros khud import (purane usi ID par badal jate hain) aur purane naam wale band. Chaabi kabhi nahi.

Sirf TikTok ki reels (For You) screen ka waqt ginta hai (har 1 min). tkLim (30) minute poore → reels par aate hi Profile tab par bhej deta (Profile / Saved / Drafts / Inbox khule). Raat 12 reset. Paani popup mein 'Aaj TikTok N min'.
